name: attic
description: a cramped, oppressive attic under the eaves. old trunks and forgotten belongings fill the space — furniture draped in white sheets that look like ghosts in the dim light. a single bare bulb hangs from a rafter, but there's no power. the air is thick with dust and the sharp smell of mothballs. scratching sounds echo from the walls — not mice, something larger.

items.name: trunk
items.description: a large steamer trunk with a rusty latch and reinforced corners. it's locked with a heavy padlock. the nameplate reads: 'e. blackwood — personal effects.' something inside is tapping against the lid.

items.name: wardrobe_attic
items.description: a tall, ornate wardrobe with a cracked mirror. inside: moth-eaten fur coats, a wedding dress yellowed with age, and a small box containing a child's christening gown and a lock of baby hair.

items.name: painting_attic
items.description: a portrait of a young woman with sad, knowing eyes, propped against the wall. the nameplate is missing. there's writing on the back: 'margaret holloway, 1850-1891. beloved. forgotten.'

items.name: candle_attic
items.description: a half-melted candle on a crate. the wax has formed a small pool around its base.

items.name: small_key
items.description: a small brass key hidden behind a loose floorboard near margaret's portrait. it's old and caked with dust.

items.name: apple_core
items.description: a dried apple core someone left here decades ago. brown and shriveled, not edible.

items.name: old_photo_album
items.description: a leather photo album filled with faded photographs of the blackwood family through the generations. the last few pages are empty, except for one photograph tucked loose: a baby's handprint in dark ink, with the date 'october 31st, 1891' written beneath.

items.name: christmas_decorations
items.description: a box of old christmas decorations: tinsel, glass ornaments, and a small wooden angel with chipped paint. the angel's face has been worn smooth, but beneath the base, someone carved: 'save us.'

exits.description: a pull-down ladder in the ceiling. cold air and darkness descend from above.
